p.espaces.b_kind_customs: Customs, freight forwarder, import-export (offering or seeking)
p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy the rules, you open the updated official sources, then read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): per product and country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs codes and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform has not been marked by a regulator before you entrust it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: The site opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand a document" for a document.For the important decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The 24/24 cross-border buying and selling guide ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do this for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): duties and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: customs codes (HS codes) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of lading (sea), Air Bill of Lading (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (businesses importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: According to the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, licence, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods approved for export to the buyer’s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risks and costs are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers at destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. These lists are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: World Remittance Prices (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash collection in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash collection, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: See the total you receive: fees + exchange rate A rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you have met only online, or to "open" a prize, package, loan or visa: it is almost always fraudulent.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, work the real price, stay in the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. Easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeiting, no regulated product without authorisation.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale/supplier listings" here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumers' rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.

p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, prescription, form or sign: read it in your language.
p.papier.private: The photo remains on your phone, and only the text that is read is sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time for this language: the phone has downloaded its reading data (some few MB).
p.papier.none: No test found. Take the photo again, flat and with more light.
p.papier.e_lib: Reading could not start: first time requires internet. Try again once connected.
p.papier.e_read: The reading failed. Take the photo again.
p.papier.e_tr: The translation could not be done (connection or daily limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: For an important document (court, health, money, residence permit), check it with someone you trust or with an association.
